## Key Figures
- **Owned Facilities (United States):** 29.9 million square feet (Source: [report.md](documents/report.md))
- **Total Facilities (United States):** 29.01 million square feet (Source: [report.md](documents/report.md))
- **Total Facilities (Other Countries):** 22.7 million square feet (Source: [report.md](documents/report.md))
- **Leased Facilities (Other Countries):** 6.0 million square feet (Source: [report.md](documents/report.md))

To find the percentage of owned facilities in the United States out of the total facilities in the United States:

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{\text{Owned Facilities (United States)}}{\text{Total Facilities (United States)}} \right) \times 100 \]

\[ \text{Percentage} = \left( \frac{29.9}{29.01} \right) \times 100 \approx 103.07\% \]
